microarch_summary: Metax C550: MXMACA compute units, on-chip multi-level storage, CUDA-like triple-angle-bracket programming model (mxcc -x maca)
memory_hierarchy: Global memory + on-chip shared memory; same origin as Lingspeed LUCA, renamed (lc_runtime.h↔mc_runtime.h)
tensor_units: MXMACA matrix units; kernels launched with __global__ + <<<grid, blk, 0, 0>>>
launch_overhead: kernel launch overhead is non-negligible relative to single-op execution → prefer operator fusion when launch-bound
onchip_memory: On-chip capacity pending real-hardware verification; large tiles require multi-level tiling
numeric_units: fp32 baseline verification passed (max_abs_err <= 1e-5); fp16/bf16 support pending real-hardware verification
isa: MXMACA DSL: mc_runtime.h / mc_common.h, mcMalloc / mcFree / mcMemcpy(HostToDevice|DeviceToHost), mcGetErrorString, mcSuccess
constraints: Dual-card same origin: lc_*↔mc_*, -x luca↔-x maca, /opt/luca↔/opt/maca (mapping verified 2026-11-23)
Compiler binary: /opt/maca/bin/mxcc (same location as lscc, pending real-hardware verification)
